ABOUT | ABOUT Why work with us? At esotec, we provide specialist integration services that include the design, installation and support of advanced surveillance and security capabilities. We offer comprehensive threat and vulnerability assessments to implement accurate and reliable protection that utilises the very latest in affordable, fully integrated site security technology. By combining our own technology with best-of-breed systems and rigorous project management, we are able to deliver turn-key solutions into secure government, national heritage, public spaces and other high-profile locations. Our knowledge of high-end surveillance and bespoke installation techniques makes us a leading provider in this specialist field.
